# hivelocity_vps_network (Resource)

Creates a private VPS network in a facility. Attach instances with `hivelocity_vps_network_attachment`. Set `vlan_id` to bridge the network to a VLAN shared with bare metal devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_vps_network" "backend" {
  facility_code = "TPA1"
  name          = "backend"
}

# Bridge a VPS network to a VLAN shared with bare metal devices.
resource "hivelocity_vlan" "shared" {
  facility_code = "TPA1"
  type          = "private"
}

resource "hivelocity_vps_network" "bridged" {
  facility_code = "TPA1"
  name          = "bridged"
  vlan_id       = hivelocity_vlan.shared.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `facility_code` (String) Facility of the network, for example `TPA1`.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the network.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `vlan_id` (Number) ID of a `hivelocity_vlan` to bridge the network to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `network_id` (String) Unique ID of the network.
- `vlan_tag` (Number) VLAN tag of the bridged VLAN, if any.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the network ID
terraform import hivelocity_vps_network.backend net-abc123
```
